assertion.text: Erdős Problem #731: declared status 'open'. Formalized: no. Find some reasonable function $f(n)$ such that, for almost all integers $n$, the least integer $m$ such that $m\nmid \binom{2n}{n}$ satisfies\[m\sim f(n).\] Prize: no. OEIS: A006197. Tags: binomial coefficients, number theory.
